The other products were very nice, except .....The Tyvek Dopp Kit? What's with that? No wonder you gave it away for free. It is truly ugly. I donated it to charity. Your website is also difficult to find customer service for a product problem. It couldn't find my order [order-id] email, phone number, or order [order-id] despite stating that any of these entered would be able to serve as a lookup.
